Element.attribute: MAR 2018 - Contributing Agile specific guidance elements

This work product contains detailed notes on areas for project improvement as well as issue resolutions and how to avoid them in the future. All learning from the project is documented in this log. Provides a structured method to capture project team insight. Often the insight of the person performing the work provides the best source for improvement ideas

The team summarizes what went well in the engagement and identifies areas that need improvement from a team perspective regarding delivery of service to the client, team interaction, coordination, etc. This step gives valuable input into optimization of future engagements. On an individual level, it may help identify input for their personal development plan for the year.

Note: In some situations, the Lessons Learned discussion may include client personnel. As such, internal EY content should be addressed separately.
To capture the knowledge gained during a project which shows how project events were addressed or should be addressed in the future with the purpose of improving future performance.
